name: Rust
onCreateCommand: if command -v apt-get; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler; elif command -v dnf; then dnf install -y protobuf-compiler; fi
postCreateCommand: git submodule update --init --recursive && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && curl -sSL https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl/releases/download/v1.9.3/grpcurl_1.9.3_linux_x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C ~/.local/bin grpcurl
